This recreates the source’s threatened collapse and analog-time punchline in natural Spanish. The bogeyman image becomes «monstruo tecnológico»; the joke and attitude survive. It loses the English receipt metaphor and gains a clear transition to the examples; the earlier severity dispute is moot.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"5807cab794b034a97f95","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The candidate uses «¿Quién se rasga hoy las vestiduras…?», an idiomatic, mocking question in place of «hand-wringing». It is more theatrical than the English gesture, but preserves the dismissive question followed by «Nadie. Nos adaptamos».","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"fa59452052e8dffa15af","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Cuándo la IA amplifica el aprendizaje y cuándo cortocircuita el desarrollo» explicitly retains both objects in the source, «learning» and «development», and recreates its electrical metaphor. The previous «lo» ambiguity is gone.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"cd697b1fdfe3979e48f6","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Enseñar a usarla bien y fomentar la alfabetización en IA» replaces the stiff construction while retaining both parts of «teaching its effective application, building literacy around it». It gains directness without dropping the literacy concept, as one earlier suggestion would have done.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"3f245d8e1b10a827bbf7","verdict":"reject","severity":1,"reason":"«Un mundo aumentado por la IA» conveys the source’s «AI-augmented world» and is readable for the stated developer audience. The proposed expansion of whose capabilities are augmented is an optional interpretation, as the opposing votes noted, not a necessary correction.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"7825199f82a4d812aa78","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The display strings now read «Los últimos en pensar» and «¿Humano o máquina?», correcting the capitalization previously carried over from «The Last to Think» and «Human or Machine?». The defensible plural title remains.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"682b0b6f242b2c38dd73","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Se tambalea al borde de la idiotez» now conveys the source’s «teeters on the brink of idiocy». It removes the unrelated drumming image and uses the colloquial register sought by the issue; prior disagreement over how severe the old error was does not change the repair.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"0735478a3af5684de675","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The candidate’s «repasemos el historial de estos pánicos» replaces the old payment-receipt reading of «historical receipts» with a clear challenge to examine the record. The metaphor is lost, but the skeptical purpose and transition are preserved.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"755b77220492292a156e","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Se rasga hoy las vestiduras» is the established expression that the earlier «se rasga las manos» appeared to blend. It keeps the pointed rhetorical beat of the source’s «hand-wringing», although it evokes theatrical indignation more than anxious hand movement.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"2c3b5e44793158b426ae","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"Both instances of «cuándo» are accented in «cuándo la IA amplifica el aprendizaje y cuándo cortocircuita el desarrollo». The sentence restores the source’s distinction between «learning» and «development» and removes the stiff «frente a cuando».","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"1b773531673f700f8dfa","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The candidate frontmatter now contains the source’s exact publication field, «date: 2025-05-31», alongside «modified: 2025-06-02». The earlier debate about possible pipeline effects is unnecessary to establish that the omission has been repaired.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"192195661ad2eb523fac","verdict":"reject","severity":1,"reason":"«La IA seguirá seguramente este patrón» remains a defensible rendering of «AI will surely follow this pattern». The nearby sounds may be polished, but «seguirá» and «seguramente» do not repeat a lexical root, and the proposed «sin duda» is an optional stronger phrasing. This does not warrant an open defect despite the earlier split vote.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"73e1d82fb7a9a53cbe87","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«No vaya a ser que tengamos que mirar un reloj de agujas» refers to checking a clock, as the source’s «analog timekeeping» requires. The earlier «relojería» wording is gone, while the battery joke remains.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"c220d1e849744cb55f12","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The candidate uses sentence case in «Los últimos en pensar» and «¿Humano o máquina?». That repairs the capitalization identified against the English display titles; this is the same repair covered by issue 7825199f82a4d812aa78.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"337c41b5b9790c74fb67","verdict":"reject","severity":1,"reason":"The source says «was once feared»; the candidate’s past-tense «Internet fue temido» still places that fear in the earlier sequence of panics. Adding «en su día» might improve the phrasing, but its absence does not lose the past framing, as the prior rejection found.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"dc81bd9c9a3145b2a9f3","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The introduction now says «la civilización se tambalea al borde de la idiotez» for the source’s «civilization teeters on the brink of idiocy». The nonsensical «tamborilea» image is gone. The broader opening also has natural pacing, so the disagreement about whether a full rewrite was necessary no longer matters.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"749ee9e9b8d755684b3c","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Repasemos el historial de estos pánicos» now carries the evidentiary purpose of «check our historical receipts» without the literal «recibos históricos». It gives up the receipt image and gains immediate comprehension; the prior disagreement over severity does not leave a current defect.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"4404e92083d1f46e7b77","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"The candidate contrasts «amplifica el aprendizaje» with «cortocircuita el desarrollo», matching the source’s «amplifies learning» and «short-circuits development». The development risk is explicit again, regardless of the prior severity split.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]},{"issueId":"942c11f9b1d3cbd08d28","verdict":"resolved","severity":1,"reason":"«Date: 2025-05-31» is present as the lowercase frontmatter key «date: 2025-05-31», matching the source, and «modified: 2025-06-02» remains separate. The publication-date omission identified earlier is fixed.","evidenceIds":["source","target"]}]}
